recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future work should be tracked separately for the items FHIR-40529 deliberately deferred, rather than reopened as part of this completed R5 QA issue.
issue_request: FHIR-40529 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 OO QA issue. The accepted scope was to add DeviceAssociation status, patient, and identifier search parameters and apply the value set previously intended for Device.association.statusReason to DeviceAssociation.statusReason; category binding, example reference, w5 mappings, and operator warning items were explicitly deferred for future consideration.
initial_application: The search-parameter portion was applied by d5404f7308, merged as PR #2753, adding DeviceAssociation-patient, DeviceAssociation-identifier, and DeviceAssociation-status. The statusReason terminology and binding were applied shortly after in the R5 QA period by 902ba6f126, which created the DeviceAssociation status-reason CodeSystem and ValueSet from the FHIR-32409 table, and 925b08c4bf, which bound DeviceAssociation.statusReason to that ValueSet.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists deviceassociation=DeviceAssociation, so the source/deviceassociation files are current build inputs. Later applied R6 issues refined the same area without undoing FHIR-40529: FHIR-48532 kept the same statusReason ValueSet but changed binding strength to extensible, and FHIR-46973 refined the subject/patient search-parameter descriptions and patient target. Confluence minutes confirm the 2023-02-27 vote and the 2023-03-06 QA-batch review reminder; no relevant Zulip conflict was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source already contains active DeviceAssociation-patient, DeviceAssociation-identifier, and DeviceAssociation-status search parameters, and DeviceAssociation.statusReason is bound to the DeviceAssociation Status Reason ValueSet whose CodeSystem contains attached, disconnected, failed, placed, and replaced.
